en.name: Currency symbols
en.title: Currency Symbols: Copy and Paste Money Signs ($ € £ ¥ ₹)
en.description: Copy and paste 16 currency symbols: dollar $, euro €, pound £, yen ¥, rupee ₹, won ₩ and more. Tap a tile to copy, and read how each sign is placed in a price.
en.lede: Sixteen money signs, from the dollar to the won. Tap a tile to copy it, then use it in a price list, an invoice or a spreadsheet.

body.body: The dollar $, euro €, pound £ and yen ¥ cover most price tags. The rupee ₹, won ₩, ruble ₽ and lira ₺ were added to Unicode as their countries set an official sign, so very old fonts may lack them. The baht ฿ and dong ₫ follow the same pattern. The cent ¢ and the colón ₡ are rarer but still in use.

A sign does not always name one currency. $ is used by the US, Canada, Australia and others, and ¥ is the yen in Japan and the yuan in China, so a price list should add the currency code such as USD or JPY. Placement differs too: English puts the sign before the number, while French and German usually put € after it.

faq: Is ¥ the yen or the yuan?
Both. The same sign is used for the Japanese yen (JPY) and the Chinese yuan (CNY). Write the three-letter code next to a price when the currency could be unclear.
Where does the euro sign go?
It depends on the language. English writes €5, while French and German usually write 5 €. Follow the convention of the readers you write for.

zh.name: 货币符号
zh.title: 货币符号：复制粘贴货币符号（$ € £ ¥ ₹）
zh.description: 一键复制 16 个货币符号：美元 $、欧元 €、英镑 £、日元 ¥、卢比 ₹、韩元 ₩ 等。点击方块即可复制，并看一看价格里符号的位置。
zh.lede: 十六个货币符号，从美元到韩元。点击方块复制，再用在价目表、发票或电子表格里。

body.body: 美元 $、欧元 €、英镑 £ 和日元 ¥ 覆盖了大部分价签。卢比 ₹、韩元 ₩、卢布 ₽ 和里拉 ₺ 是在各国确定官方符号之后才加入 Unicode 的，所以很旧的字体可能没有。泰铢 ฿ 和越南盾 ₫ 也属于同类。美分 ¢ 和科朗 ₡ 比较少见，但仍在使用。
一个符号不一定只对应一种货币。$ 被美国、加拿大、澳大利亚等国使用，¥ 在日本是日元，在中国是人民币，所以价目表最好再写上 USD 或 JPY 这样的货币代码。位置也不同：英语把符号放在数字前，法语和德语通常把 € 放在数字后。

faq: 两者都是。日元（JPY）和人民币（CNY）用的是同一个符号。币种可能不清楚时，在价格旁边写上三个字母的代码。
取决于语言。英语写 €5，法语和德语通常写 5 €。按你的读者的习惯来写。
